commands.text: Mera pins the damaged book beneath a clear board. Beside it, Tovin's account is held open by his own hammer.

commands.speaker: ac_mera_holt
commands.text: Both stay. The missing names, and the man who helped remove them.

commands.speaker: ac_tovin_reed
commands.text: I will answer when they come.

commands.speaker: jori_flint
commands.text: You will also keep the road clear for them.

commands.speaker: ac_mera_holt
commands.text: The last carrier has scraps from every corner of the yard. It keeps bringing the load home.

commands.speaker: jori_flint
commands.text: Then give it no closed gate to lean on.

commands.speaker: ac_tovin_reed
commands.text: Three posts. The gate, the shelter, the pit. I will keep a lamp at each.
